sections.Profile:
"Pretty Baby," designed by Steve Kordek and released by Williams Manufacturing Co. in January 1965, is a two-player electro-mechanical pinball machine. The game features two flippers, three pop bumpers, six passive bumpers, and two kick-out holes protected by drop targets.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1965
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: Two player, Women, Original Theme, Single level playfield
